description: Unofficial Vault Boy fan art inspired by Fallout. Fully clothed in a simplified blue-and-yellow jumpsuit, he tidies his sleeves for a cheerful thumbs-up, checks an abstract-symbol handbook, repairs a harmless small gear and recovers from a fumbled page. Original nine-state choreography with three-direction alternating-leg runs; no weapons, vault numerals or official endorsement.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
